post.summary: Issue an owner-only scoped credential; token returned once
post.description: Integrations allow read/evidence.verify; agents allow read, people.read and worker scopes. People mutations require people.read. Task capabilities require assignments unless accessMode is workspace. Workspace access is agent-only, requires empty assignments, and covers current and future work records. Workspace management capabilities require workspace access. workstream.manage additionally permits organizational fields with workstream.update; it is not a command. Default accessMode is assigned. Expiry defaults to 90 days and must be future within 366 days. Equivalent retries do not return the token again.
